claimLedger.claim: Mid-luteal progesterone day 21 of 28-day cycle; later and weekly repeats in prolonged irregular cycles; do not use BBT charts to confirm ovulation
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · Fertility problems: assessment and treatment (NG257) — investigation chapter · Published 31 March 2026 (recommendations tagged [2004]/CG156 lineage)
claimLedger.limitations: UK NICE pathway; CG156 page now redirects to NG257—same progesterone recommendations retained

claimLedger.claim: Regular unprotected sex every 2 or 3 days; most under-40 couples conceive within a year
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Infertility — Overview · Page last reviewed: 09 August 2023
claimLedger.limitations: UK population figures; individual history can shorten the wait before assessment

claimLedger.claim: Temperature rises after ovulation; fertile mucus becomes clearer and slippery; apps not completely reliable; PCOS can change fertility signs
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS Inform · Natural family planning (fertility awareness) · Last updated: 26 March 2026
claimLedger.limitations: Written mainly for contraception/fertility awareness; still useful for describing mucus and BBT physiology

claimLedger.claim: Ovulation usually about 14 days before next period depending on cycle length
